blocks.content: First of all, congratulations on completing this course on recursion. We hope you liked it as much as we enjoyed creating it.
The next step would be to practice what you have learned in this course. It's the only way you can get better at programming.
If you are comfortable with recursion, consider taking the Data Structures and Algorithms With Java course, which will be published soon in the future.
Understanding DSA enables us to write efficient code. That's why DSA-related questions are asked by many top companies, including Google, Facebook, and Netflix, during their interview.
We hope to see you in the DSA course!
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
